newsitem.title: USA: Chartwell Re forms Capitol Insurance.
newsitem.headline: Chartwell Re forms Capitol Insurance.

text.p: Chartwell Re Corp said on Monday that it has formed Capitol Insurance Managers LLC, a new managing general agent, with managers of American Eagle Insurance Co's property and casualty business.
Capitol Insurance will be owned 80 percent by executives of American Eagle's property and casualty and 20 percent by Chartwell, the company said.
Formation of Capitol Insurance is pending execution of definitive agreements and approval from directors and regulators, Chartwell said.
Capitol Insurance has tentatively agreed to buy substantially all of the assets and continuing Artisans Contractor business of American Eagle's property and casualty division.
American Eagle will continue to issue policies on its own paper until a Chartwell Re indirect subsidiary gets all required regulatory approvals.
The 1996 gross premiums written by American Eagle's Artisans Contractor line of business were approximately $22 million, Chartwell said.
